missions.title: Inspect and preserve all existing GhostCorp VR prototypes and assets
acceptance: Locate actual repositories and prototype files
Inventory reusable models, scenes, interactions, and visual assets
Record prototype limitations and preserve source

missions.title: Validate native Godot 4 and OpenXR compatibility on target headset
acceptance: Confirm headset model and supported OpenXR runtime from available project/device evidence
Build a minimal native Android VR test app
Verify headset/controller tracking and frame performance

missions.title: Build native GhostCorp VR application foundation
acceptance: Installed native app, not browser/WebXR
OpenXR runtime integration
Scene loading and persistence
Comfort and safety controls

missions.title: Implement authenticated Jarvis World Control API
acceptance: Typed scene/entity/environment operations
Authentication and scoped authorization
Audit events and rollback snapshots
No arbitrary shell execution through world API

missions.title: Give Jarvis autonomous world-building and world-operations authority
acceptance: Jarvis creates and edits sandbox scenes
Controls lighting, objects, NPCs, physics, navigation, portals
Can save, inspect, test, and rollback changes
Routine reversible tasks need no owner action

missions.title: Create isolated public worlds and private owner-only GhostCorp campus
acceptance: Separate public and private security domains
Server-side auth on every private operation
Public visitors cannot access business data or controls

missions.title: Build in-world development studio and game test pipeline
acceptance: Jarvis can create sandbox game worlds
Build, test, profile, and compare versions
Owner can observe results in VR
Failed builds rollback safely

missions.title: Prove native VR performance and deployment on headset
acceptance: Installed and launched on actual headset
Frame-time/memory/thermal test evidence
Signed update and recovery path
